articles.body:
Hi Jonas,

Our accountant is setting up the import on her side and asks which column in the nightly file holds the grantee number. She sees "party_ref" and "counterparty" and they are not always the same.

/Nina
articles.subject: Bookkeeping export: which field carries the grantee number?

articles.body:
Hi Nina,

party_ref is the grantee number as registered in Grantly. counterparty is the payee on the disbursement, which differs when a grant is paid to a project account rather than the organisation itself.

For bookkeeping she should use party_ref.

Regards,
Jonas Frid
articles.subject: Re: Bookkeeping export: which field carries the grantee number?

articles.body: Perfect, she has it working. Thank you.
